desc: The relay's diet, two players in different rooms at real speed: neither draws the other, so each game's places go twice a second; a change of state (the guest into a battle of its own) still reaches the host at once. At most 300 messages a minute of play each (0.5.0: 1,200). The host plays in Rogueport (gor_01): in hei_01 its story-11 scene pulled the guest in, and the guest's battle was shared
